description.en: Belgrade's historic citadel, set on the bluff where the Sava meets the Danube. Walk the ramparts, find the Victor monument, and watch sunset from the upper town.
description.sr_lat: Beogradska istorijska tvrđava na uzvisini gde se Sava uliva u Dunav. Prošetajte bedemima, pronađite Pobednika i posmatrajte zalazak sunca iz gornjeg grada.

description.en: One of the largest Orthodox churches in the world. The interior mosaic, completed in 2020, is breathtaking — look up.
description.sr_lat: Jedna od najvećih pravoslavnih crkava na svetu. Unutrašnji mozaik, završen 2020. godine, oduzima dah — pogledajte gore.

description.en: Cobblestoned, lantern-lit street of traditional kafanas. Live tamburica music most nights. Tourist-leaning but charming.
description.sr_lat: Kaldrmisom popločana, fenjerima osvetljena ulica tradicionalnih kafana. Živa tamburica skoro svake večeri. Turistički nastrojena, ali šarmantna.

description.en: Former concrete warehouse on the Sava waterfront, now a row of upmarket restaurants. Best for a long sunset dinner.
description.sr_lat: Bivše betonsko skladište na savskom keju, danas niz restorana visokog nivoa. Idealno za dugi obrok uz zalazak sunca.

description.en: Belgrade's legendary floating clubs along the Sava and Danube. Genres run from techno to turbofolk; pick your splav by the music.
description.sr_lat: Legendarni beogradski splavovi duž Save i Dunava. Muzika se kreće od tehna do turbofolka — izaberite splav po zvuku.

description.en: A ramshackle former brewery courtyard hosting a dozen bars. The local alternative-scene heart, busy from Thursday on.
description.sr_lat: Zapušteno dvorište nekadašnje pivare u kom se smestilo desetak barova. Srce beogradske alternativne scene, gužva od četvrtka nadalje.

description.en: The pedestrian spine of the old town. Bookshops, ice cream, street performers, and grand 19th-century facades.
description.sr_lat: Pešačka kičma starog grada. Knjižare, sladoled, ulični svirači i veličanstvene fasade iz 19. veka.

description.en: The city's central meeting point — "kod konja" (by the horse). Anchored by the National Museum and National Theatre.
description.sr_lat: Centralno gradsko okupljalište — "kod konja". Omeđen Narodnim muzejom i Narodnim pozorištem.

description.en: Reopened in 2018 after a 15-year renovation. Strong on medieval Serbian art and a small but real Impressionist collection.
description.sr_lat: Otvoren ponovo 2018. godine nakon petnaestogodišnje rekonstrukcije. Bogata zbirka srednjovekovne srpske umetnosti i manja, ali autentična impresionistička kolekcija.

description.en: Compact museum in a 1920s villa with original Tesla devices and live coil demonstrations. Book ahead in summer.
description.sr_lat: Kompaktan muzej u vili iz dvadesetih godina sa originalnim Teslinim uređajima i živim demonstracijama kalemova. U leto rezervišite unapred.

description.en: Tito's resting place inside the Museum of Yugoslavia complex. Pair with the main museum for a full Yugoslav-era afternoon.
description.sr_lat: Titovo počivalište unutar kompleksa Muzeja Jugoslavije. Kombinujte s glavnim muzejom za celo popodne posvećeno jugoslovenskom dobu.

description.en: Belgrade's "Sea" — a river island turned summer beach. Swimming, kayaking, beachside cafes, and 8 km of walking paths.
description.sr_lat: Beogradsko "more" — rečno ostrvo pretvoreno u letnju plažu. Kupanje, kajaking, kafići uz vodu i 8 km pešačkih staza.

name.sr_lat: Zemunski kej i Kula na Gardošu

description.en: Walk the Danube quay through old Zemun, then climb to Gardoš Tower for the postcard view back over the rooftops.
description.sr_lat: Prošetajte dunavskim kejem kroz stari Zemun, pa se popnite do Kule na Gardošu za panoramski pogled na krovove.

description.en: Hilltop tower above Zemun built in 1896. Best sunset viewpoint in greater Belgrade.
description.sr_lat: Kula na brdu iznad Zemuna, podignuta 1896. Najbolje mesto za gledanje zalaska sunca u široj okolini Beograda.

description.en: Art-Nouveau landmark from 1908. Order the Moskva Šnit cake with a coffee and watch all of Belgrade walk past.
description.sr_lat: Secesijska znamenitost iz 1908. godine. Naručite Moskva Šnit uz kafu i posmatrajte kako pola Beograda prolazi.

description.en: Belgrade's oldest kafana (1823), opposite the cathedral. The name is the literal punctuation — long story involving the church.
description.sr_lat: Najstarija beogradska kafana (1823), nasuprot katedrale. Ime je bukvalno interpunkcijski znak — duga priča u kojoj učestvuje crkva.

description.en: Hidden courtyard café with a fig tree at the centre. Brunch and shaded tables; arrive early on weekends.
description.sr_lat: Skriveni dvorišni kafić sa smokvom u centru. Brunch i stolovi u hladovini — vikendom dođite ranije.

description.en: Central park around Saint Mark's Church. Locals jog here; in summer, open-air concerts.
description.sr_lat: Centralni park oko Crkve Svetog Marka. Meštani trče ovde; leti se održavaju koncerti na otvorenom.

description.en: Serbo-Byzantine red-and-yellow brick church holding the tomb of Tsar Dušan. Quieter than Saint Sava, often overlooked.
description.sr_lat: Srpsko-vizantijska crkva od crvene i žute opeke u kojoj se čuva grob cara Dušana. Mirnija od Hrama Svetog Save, često previđena.

description.en: The only surviving Ottoman mosque in Belgrade, dating to the 1570s. Tucked into a narrow Dorćol street.
description.sr_lat: Jedina preživela osmanska džamija u Beogradu, iz 1570-ih godina. Sakriven u uskoj dorćolskoj ulici.

description.en: 1830s Balkan-Ottoman townhouse, fully furnished. The smallest, most personal museum in town.
description.sr_lat: Balkansko-osmanska gradska kuća iz 1830-ih, potpuno nameštena. Najmanji i najintimniji muzej u gradu.

description.en: Inside the Kalemegdan walls — strange and atmospheric, white tigers among the ramparts. Conditions are modest; bring perspective.
description.sr_lat: Unutar kalemegdanskih bedema — neobično i atmosferično, beli tigrovi među zidinama. Uslovi su skromni; dođite sa razumevanjem.

description.en: The 200-m pylon cable-stayed bridge that defines the modern skyline. Walk the pedestrian deck for river views.
description.sr_lat: Viseći most sa 200-metarskim pilonom koji definiše savremenu siluetu grada. Prošetajte pešačkom stazom za pogled na reku.

description.en: The walking deck across the Sava, between Old Belgrade and Novi Beograd. Best at blue hour.
description.sr_lat: Pešačka staza preko Save, između starog Beograda i Novog Beograda. Najlepše u plavi sat.

description.en: Polished new riverside promenade running south from Beton Hala. Controversial development, pleasant walk.
description.sr_lat: Uređena nova savska promenada koja se proteže južno od Beton hale. Kontroverzni projekat, prijatna šetnja.

description.en: Industrial-chic neighbourhood between the train tracks and the river. Galleries by day, bars by night.
description.sr_lat: Industrijsko-šik četvrt između pruge i reke. Galerije danju, barovi noću.

description.en: Tiny Balkan-era house turned ethnographic museum. Costumes, textiles, and old Belgrade photographs.
description.sr_lat: Mala balkanska kuća pretvorena u etnografski muzej. Nošnje, tekstil i stare fotografije Beograda.

description.en: Royal-residence park with one of Europe's oldest plane trees (over 180 years). Picnic-perfect.
description.sr_lat: Park kraljevske rezidencije sa jednim od najstarijih platana u Evropi (stariji od 180 godina). Idealno za piknik.

description.en: 204-m TV tower on Avala mountain, 16 km out of town. Clear-day views to the Pannonian plain. Bus 401 from Voždovac.
description.sr_lat: TV toranj visok 204 m na planini Avali, 16 km od centra. Po vedrom vremenu pogled seže do Panonske nizije. Autobus 401 iz Voždovca.

description.en: Industrial techno club inside a former slaughterhouse. Friday/Saturday only, open late.
description.sr_lat: Industrijski tehno klub u nekadašnjoj klanici. Radi samo petkom i subotom, do dugo u noć.

description.en: Specialty-coffee shop in Dorćol with consistent flat whites and an industrial fit-out. Take it to the river.
description.sr_lat: Specijalna kafeterija u Dorćolu sa pouzdanim flat whiteom i industrijskim enterijerom. Ponesite kafu do reke.

description.en: Dorćol concept store with all-day brunch and a courtyard. Vegetarian-friendly, design-leaning crowd.
description.sr_lat: Dorćolski concept store sa brunchom tokom celog dana i dvorištem. Vegetarijancima prijatan, publika iz sveta dizajna.

description.en: Vauban-style citadel above the Danube opposite Novi Sad, with a famous clock tower, casemate tunnels, and sweeping river views. Hosts the EXIT music festival each July.
description.sr_lat: Tvrđava u Vobanovom stilu iznad Dunava, naspram Novog Sada. Poznata po toranjskom satu, kazamatskim tunelima i panoramskim pogledima na reku. Svakog jula domaćin je EXIT festivala.

notes.en: From Novi Sad station ~15 min walk across the Varadin Bridge, or local bus 3/4 to Petrovaradin.
notes.sr_lat: Od železničke stanice Novi Sad ~15 min hoda preko Varadinskog mosta, ili autobus 3/4 do Petrovaradina.

description.en: Half-kilometre city beach on the Danube in Novi Sad, with sand, sun loungers, river swimming, and summer cafés. Open and lifeguarded May through September.
description.sr_lat: Gradska plaža na Dunavu u Novom Sadu, dugačka pola kilometra. Pesak, ležaljke, kupanje u reci i letnji kafići. Otvorena i pod nadzorom spasilaca od maja do septembra.

notes.en: From Novi Sad station ~25 min walk south to the riverside, or city bus 4 toward Liman.
notes.sr_lat: Od železničke stanice Novi Sad ~25 min hoda na jug do obale, ili gradski autobus 4 ka Limanu.

description.en: Hungarian Art Nouveau masterpiece (Komor & Jakab, 1910) on the main square, with a stained-glass council chamber and a clock-tower observation deck.
description.sr_lat: Remek-delo mađarske secesije (Komor i Jakab, 1910) na glavnom trgu. Veće sa vitražima i vidikovac na satnoj kuli.

notes.en: Not every Soko continues past Novi Sad; check the current PDF schedule at srbvoz.rs. From Subotica station ~15 min walk to Trg slobode.
notes.sr_lat: Ne nastavljaju svi Soko vozovi posle Novog Sada; proverite važeći red vožnje na srbvoz.rs. Od stanice ~15 min hoda do Trga slobode.

description.en: Hungarian Art Nouveau synagogue from 1902, one of the most striking in Central Europe — restored 2018, with stained-glass cupolas and floral motifs.
description.sr_lat: Mađarska secesijska sinagoga iz 1902, jedna od najupečatljivijih u srednjoj Evropi. Obnovljena 2018, sa vitražnim kupolama i cvetnim motivima.

notes.en: Same train as Subotica City Hall; from Subotica station ~10 min walk north.
notes.sr_lat: Isti voz kao za Gradsku kuću; od stanice ~10 min hoda na sever.

name.sr_lat: Saborna crkva Svetog Nikole, Sremski Karlovci

description.en: Serbian Orthodox cathedral on the main square of the wine-village Sremski Karlovci, seat of the historic Patriarchate, with a richly painted iconostasis from 1780.
description.sr_lat: Srpska pravoslavna saborna crkva na glavnom trgu vinogradarskog mestašca Sremski Karlovci. Sedište istorijske Patrijaršije. Bogato oslikan ikonostas iz 1780. godine.

notes.en: Regional service via the legacy Belgrade-Novi Sad line (not the Soko corridor). Verify current departures at srbvoz.rs — service is limited compared to Soko, but the local train stops directly at Karlovci village. Alternative: take Soko to Novi Sad (36 min) then local bus 61 or taxi (15 min).
notes.sr_lat: Regionalna linija preko stare pruge Beograd-Novi Sad (ne preko brze Soko-pruge). Proverite važeći red vožnje na srbvoz.rs — broj polazaka je manji nego za Soko, ali ovaj voz staje u samim Karlovcima. Alternativa: Soko do Novog Sada (36 min) pa lokalni autobus 61 ili taksi (15 min).

description.en: Medieval Serbian fortified capital on the Danube, 1430s — one of the largest plain fortresses in Europe, with 25 towers and an inner city of palaces in ruins.
description.sr_lat: Srednjovekovna prestonica Srpske despotovine na Dunavu iz 1430-ih. Jedna od najvećih ravničarskih tvrđava u Evropi, sa 25 kula i unutrašnjim gradom palata u ruševinama.

notes.en: Train service to Smederevo is limited as of 2026 — typically 1-2 daily departures, sometimes replaced by rail-bus. Verify on srbvoz.rs the morning of travel. Reliable fallback: intercity-bus from BAS (~1 h, departures every 30 min). From Smederevo station ~20 min walk to the fortress.
notes.sr_lat: Vozno povezivanje sa Smederevom je u 2026. ograničeno — obično 1-2 dnevna polaska, ponekad zamenjena železničkim autobusom. Proverite na srbvoz.rs ujutru pre puta. Pouzdana alternativa: međugradski autobus sa BAS (~1 h, polasci na svakih 30 min). Od železničke stanice ~20 min hoda do tvrđave.

name.sr_lat: Crkva Svetog Đorđa na Oplencu (Mauzolej Karađorđevića)

description.en: Royal mausoleum of the Karađorđević dynasty crowning Oplenac hill above Topola. Marble exterior, mosaic interior copying 60 medieval Serbian churches, and the crypt of King Petar I.
description.sr_lat: Kraljevski mauzolej dinastije Karađorđević na vrhu brda Oplenac iznad Topole. Mermerna spoljašnjost, unutrašnji mozaici koji repliciraju 60 srednjovekovnih srpskih crkava, i kripta kralja Petra I.

notes.en: Operators include Sandžaktrans, Pupd Janjušević, Joe Travel. Times sourced 11 May 2026 from polazak.rs aggregator. From Topola station 15-20 min walk uphill to Oplenac or local taxi.
notes.sr_lat: Prevoznici: Sandžaktrans, Pupd Janjušević, Joe Travel. Vremena preuzeta 11. maja 2026. iz agregatora polazak.rs. Od autobuske stanice u Topoli 15-20 min hoda uzbrdo do Oplenca ili lokalni taksi.

description.en: Landscape park with mineral springs, the 19th-century Knez Mihailov konak, and the Bela Stena marble-sculpture park — anchor of the Aranđelovac spa town.
description.sr_lat: Park sa mineralnim izvorima, konakom kneza Mihaila iz 19. veka, i parkom mermernih skulptura Bela Stena — centar banje Aranđelovac.

notes.en: Operators include Lasta, Transprodukt. 14 daily departures; fares 670-710 RSD one-way per polazak.rs (11 May 2026). From station ~10 min walk to the spa park.
notes.sr_lat: Prevoznici: Lasta, Transprodukt. 14 dnevnih polaska; cena 670-710 RSD jednosmerno po polazak.rs (11. maj 2026). Od stanice ~10 min hoda do banje.

description.en: Sava-river town with an Ottoman fortress, the 1865 Jefimija quay promenade, and the cathedral Crkva Svetih Apostola Petra i Pavla. Mačvanski Folk Museum on the main square.
description.sr_lat: Grad na Savi sa osmanlijskom tvrđavom, šetalištem Jefimija iz 1865. i Crkvom Svetih Apostola Petra i Pavla. Mačvanski narodni muzej na glavnom trgu.

notes.en: Operators include Raketa AB, Lastra, Mačva Expres, Banbus. Verified 11 May 2026 via polazak.rs. Regional train (Srbijavoz) also serves this route at 09:50 daily.
notes.sr_lat: Prevoznici: Raketa AB, Lastra, Mačva Expres, Banbus. Provereno 11. maj 2026. preko polazak.rs. Regionalni voz (Srbijavoz) saobraća u 09:50 dnevno.

description.en: Elegant Austro-Hungarian spa town in western Serbia near the Drina river — sulphur springs, the 1908 Royal Bathhouse, and a tree-lined promenade.
description.sr_lat: Elegantna austrougarska banja u zapadnoj Srbiji pored Drine — sumporni izvori, Kraljevsko kupatilo iz 1908. i drvored za šetnju.

notes.en: Operators include Raketa AB, Lastra, Banbus. 19 daily departures Belgrade→Loznica per polazak.rs (11 May 2026). From Loznica station local bus or 7 km taxi to Banja Koviljača (~10 min).
notes.sr_lat: Prevoznici: Raketa AB, Lastra, Banbus. 19 dnevnih polaska Beograd→Loznica po polazak.rs (11. maj 2026). Od stanice u Loznici lokalni autobus ili 7 km taksi do Banje Koviljače (~10 min).

description.en: Belgrade-municipality town with the Selters Banja mineral park, the 1903 Saint Petka church, and the surrounding Kosmaj hills for hiking.
description.sr_lat: Mestašce u Beogradskoj opštini sa parkom mineralne vode Selters Banja, Crkvom Svete Petke iz 1903. i obližnjim brdima Kosmaj za planinarenje.

notes.en: BG:Voz line 3 (Mladenovac—Ovča/Zemun via Belgrade Centre). Approximate times; verify current schedule at srbvoz.rs the day of travel.
notes.sr_lat: BG:Voz linija 3 (Mladenovac—Ovča/Zemun preko Beograda Centra). Vremena su približna; proverite važeći red vožnje na srbvoz.rs na dan putovanja.

description.en: Coal-country town south-west of Belgrade with the Saint Demetrius church-memorial complex commemorating the 1914 Kolubara Battle, and the Đorđe Andrejević Kun art collection.
description.sr_lat: Mestašce jugozapadno od Beograda, centar rudarskog basena, sa crkvom-spomenikom Svetog Dimitrija u sećanje na Kolubarsku bitku 1914. i umetničkom zbirkom Đorđa Andrejevića Kuna.

notes.en: BG:Voz line 4 (Lazarevac—Ovča via Belgrade Centre). Approximate times — line 4 has fewer departures than line 3; verify at srbvoz.rs the day of travel.
notes.sr_lat: BG:Voz linija 4 (Lazarevac—Ovča preko Beograda Centra). Približna vremena — linija 4 ima manje polaska od linije 3; proverite na srbvoz.rs na dan putovanja.

description.en: Meštrović's 1938 marble mausoleum on the summit of Avala, eight caryatids in regional dress flanking the crypt. Sweeping views toward Belgrade and the Šumadija hills.
description.sr_lat: Mermerni mauzolej Ivana Meštrovića iz 1938. na vrhu Avale, sa osam karijatida u narodnim nošnjama oko kripte. Pogled na Beograd i šumadijska brda.

notes.en: GSP line 401 (Voždovac—Avala) — approximate hourly through the day. BusPlus card or paper ticket at the entry. From the terminus 5-10 min walk uphill to the monument; the Avala Tower viewpoint is 400 m further.
notes.sr_lat: GSP linija 401 (Voždovac—Avala) — približno satnica tokom dana. BusPlus kartica ili papirna karta na ulazu. Od stanice 5-10 min hoda uzbrdo do spomenika; vidikovac Avala je 400 m dalje.

description.en: One of the largest Neolithic settlements in Europe (5700–4500 BC), excavated since 1908 — type site of the Vinča culture. Visitor centre with reconstructions and original artefacts.
description.sr_lat: Jedno od najvećih neolitskih naselja u Evropi (5700–4500. p.n.e), istraživano od 1908. — tip-lokalitet vinčanske kulture. Posetilački centar sa rekonstrukcijama i originalnim nalazima.

notes.en: GSP lines 304E and 313 from Pančevački most or Trg Republike. From Vinča village ~10 min walk to the visitor centre. Schedule approximate — verify on gsp.rs day of travel.
notes.sr_lat: GSP linije 304E i 313 sa Pančevačkog mosta ili Trga Republike. Od Vinče ~10 min hoda do posetiteljskog centra. Raspored je približan — proverite na gsp.rs na dan putovanja.

description.en: Forested 626 m peak south of Belgrade, with the 1971 partisan memorial of five concrete spikes by Vojin Stojić — a Yugoslav modernist landmark. Marked hiking trails through oak and beech forest.
description.sr_lat: Šumovit vrh od 626 m južno od Beograda, sa partizanskim spomenikom iz 1971. — pet betonskih šiljaka koje je projektovao Vojin Stojić, simbol jugoslovenskog modernizma. Obeležene staze kroz hrastovu i bukovu šumu.

notes.en: GSP line 411 (Trošarina—Sopot). From Sopot bus station the marked Kosmaj trail is ~5 km / 90 min on foot to the summit and memorial. Allow a full day. Schedule approximate; verify on gsp.rs.
notes.sr_lat: GSP linija 411 (Trošarina—Sopot). Od autobuske stanice u Sopotu obeležena staza ka Kosmaju je ~5 km / 90 min hoda do vrha i spomenika. Računajte na ceo dan. Raspored je približan; proverite na gsp.rs.

description.en: Vojvodina ridgeline studded with 16 Serbian Orthodox monasteries (the "Holy Mount"), oak-and-linden forest, vineyard villages, and panoramic ridge roads.
description.sr_lat: Planinski venac u Vojvodini sa 16 srpskih pravoslavnih manastira (Sveta gora Srbije), hrastovo-lipovim šumama, vinogradarskim selima i panoramskim putevima.

notes.en: Most travellers take Soko to Novi Sad (36 min) then local bus 53/74 to Irig village (40 min); the intercity bus listed above goes via Šid. Best monasteries (Krušedol, Velika Remeta) need a taxi or guided day-tour from Irig.
notes.sr_lat: Većina putnika ide Soko-vozom do Novog Sada (36 min) pa lokalnim autobusom 53/74 do Iriga (40 min); međugradski autobus iznad ide preko Šida. Najpoznatiji manastiri (Krušedol, Velika Remeta) zahtevaju taksi ili organizovanu turu iz Iriga.

description.en: Capital of Roman Moesia Superior — amphitheatre, mausolea, baths, and a third-century mammoth-skeleton find. Onsite reconstructions and a visitor centre 12 km east of Požarevac.
description.sr_lat: Prestonica rimske provincije Gornje Mezije — amfiteatar, mauzoleji, terme i nalaz mamutovog skeleta iz 3. veka. Rekonstrukcije i posetilački centar 12 km istočno od Požarevca.

hours.raw: Apr-Oct Tu-Su 09:00-19:00; Nov-Mar Tu-Su 09:00-16:00; Mo closed

notes.en: Frequent BAS departures to Požarevac (Lasta, Sirius); from Požarevac a 12 km taxi to the Viminacium site (~15 min). Some operators run direct charter day-tours from Belgrade in season — check viminacium.org.rs.
notes.sr_lat: Česti polasci sa BAS-a ka Požarevcu (Lasta, Sirius); od Požarevca taksi 12 km do lokaliteta (~15 min). Pojedini prevoznici organizuju direktne dnevne ture iz Beograda u sezoni — proverite na viminacium.org.rs.

description.en: World-renowned Slovak naïve-painting tradition. Founded 1955, the Kovačica gallery shows 1,200+ works by self-taught village painters — Banat scenes, harvests, and folk dance.
description.sr_lat: Svetski poznata tradicija slovačkog naivnog slikarstva. Osnovana 1955, kovačička galerija pokazuje preko 1.200 dela samoukih seoskih slikara — banatski pejzaži, žetve, folklor.

notes.en: Operators include Lasta and APP Aleksinac. From the bus station ~5 min walk to the gallery on Masarikova.
notes.sr_lat: Prevoznici: Lasta, APP Aleksinac. Od autobuske stanice ~5 min hoda do galerije u Masarikovoj ulici.
